versions.content: When storing contained I - PDUs into Container PD Us and IpduMContainedTxPduPriorityHandling is set to FALSE, the IpduM shall retain the order in which the contained I - PDUs are passed to IpduM. That is the first passed contained I - PDU is placed at the beginning at the container and so on. If a contained I - PDU with IpduMContainedTxPduCollectionSemantics set to IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST is passed multiple times, the IpduM shall store it only once at the position matching its first occurrence .
